title: Create : Simple Gearboxes
body:
Add some Gearbox for Create!

6way Gearbox
Elbow Gearbox


![Introduction photo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7f6bb6b94ce46e0843a9148e35c8da8c5514e3e2_0.webp)


Recipe

To make a 6-way gearbox, combine 6 gears and 1 andesite casing, or 2 gears and 1 gearbox, or 4 gears and 1 elbow gearbox.

To make an elbow gearbox, combine 2 gears and 1 andesite casing!
